title: Leaving Billie in early 1944
summary: After a quarrel over money, he beat her and left, and she begged him by phone to return.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her

blocks.x: But one night, I lost some money in a crap game and I went home and looked in her dresser drawer and you talk about trying to find a bra or trying to find the right socks, stockings (laughter) or panties, boy I was throwing things out of that drawer for an hour and when I finally ended up, I found ten dollars.

I say what? Now I know she's got it. I say well I'll being seeing you. So I packed up my bag and I just bought a brand new gabardine top coat, name dropping, from Phil Cromfields Store in New York. And I'm starting out the door and she's hollering, please don't go, please don't go. And like from the bedroom to the living room, we never closed the doors, the glass doors, we always kept them open, those little doors, you know, jammed between the doors, between the rooms, you know the little up lift. She tripped and caught hold of the coat tail of my go boarder coat that I had just bought and tore it right up the back near the seam up to the collar.

I set my bag down, took off all of my clothes except my shorts, just like I was going in the ring with Sugar Ray (laughter), I tried to kill her. Then I got the whip. I got tired of the whip, I got the brush and started pecking her in

the top of the head with it. She tried to jump out the window, I wouldn't let her. I say come on back here, (laughter). So I left. Every night, she was across the street, please come back, please come back. No good. No good. I played, I'd done what I could do.

But I think I stranded her, I think I should have stayed with her a little while longer. But having had it and know what it involved and could tell, I just didn't want to be around it. In the meanwhile, Charlie Parker had just hit the scene too. So this was the Vogue, you know, but she had never thought of doing it until this white boy had introduced her to it, you know.
How long had you and she been together?

Two years. So it ended up, I came out here. She was making long distance phone calls. I'll give you anything you want, I'll stop, please take me back. No good. Hang up in her face. So from then on, I was on all of her record dates in spite of that, you know.
